sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Armor stand is a furniture item that can be built using the Hammer within the range of a Workbench. It also increases the Comfort level by 1 when placed, regardless if any equipment is placed on it.
Its purpose is to display a set of Armor, a Weapon and a Shield. The player can mix and match any armor piece and most weapon / shield combos. The Armor Stand is an alternative to storing armor in a Chest.
